frozen_fixpoint_selector.controller: R37B byte-frozen fixed certified portfolio restart cycle

allowed: materialize the exact canonical portfolio fixpoint and preserve its clause list/hash
compute polynomial structural statistics independent of known SAT truth
recognize standard tractable syntactic/structural classes using deterministic polynomial recognition only
record a witness for positive class recognition so a later gate can integrate that already-known polynomial solver
forbidden: using the R36 known SAT truth to choose or tune a class recognizer
using a bounded-width/FPT probe as a P-time claim
post-hoc changing the fixpoint selector after structure results

RENAMABLE_HORN.recognition: Reduce the choice of variable polarity flips to a 2-SAT constraint system enforcing at most one positive literal in every renamed clause; recognition is polynomial.
RENAMABLE_HORN.scientific_use: If positive, preserve the renaming witness only. A separate gate must integrate a standard Horn solver on the renamed formula.

DUAL_HORN.recognition: Every clause has at most one negative literal.
DUAL_HORN.scientific_use: If positive, preserve as an already-known Schaefer tractable class.

BETA_ACYCLIC.recognition: Repeatedly eliminate a weakly simplicial variable whose incident hyperedges form an inclusion chain; this yields a polynomial recognition/elimination witness for beta-acyclic CNFs.
BETA_ACYCLIC.scientific_use: If positive, later integrate the known polynomial Davis-Putnam elimination for this class.

Q_HORN.literature_status: Known linear-time recognizable/solvable class generalizing Horn, quadratic and disguised Horn.
Q_HORN.R38_policy: Literature candidate only in this gate unless a fully audited exact q-Horn recognizer is separately preregistered; do not infer q-Horn from approximate statistics.

BACKDOOR_OR_TREEWIDTH.R38_policy: Measure only as non-authoritative structure. FPT dependence or small observed parameter is not P without a universal polynomial bound on the parameter and detection cost.

captain_obvious_law: WHEN A POLYNOMIALLY TERMINATING PORTFOLIO STOPS, FIRST ASK WHETHER THE FIXPOINT ALREADY BELONGS TO A KNOWN POLYNOMIAL LANGUAGE. RECOGNITION MUST ITSELF BE POLYNOMIAL AND EXACT.

next_gate_policy.if_recognized: Create one separate preregistered gate integrating only the standard solver for the first recognized class in frozen priority RENAMABLE_HORN, DUAL_HORN, BETA_ACYCLIC. Then run a new prospective holdout after sealing.
next_gate_policy.if_none: Return to TOPA/Captain with the exact fixpoint and choose at most one new audited mechanism; q-Horn may be preregistered next only with a complete exact recognizer.
